focus: Angle 1 [logic] — typed tool outcomes, one safe execution seam, per-turn interruption, streamed-error-safe retry without tools, and shared step ceilings.

graphEvents.label: Every tool outcome is normalized to typed status and bounded model content
Built-in and extension tools share one defensive executor
Interruption is returned as per-turn truth
No-tools retry is allowed only before first streamed output
One configurable tool-call ceiling covers JS and native loops
OGAM generation tool loop and tool result contract

label: Normalize every tool return or throw to ok, empty, or error with coarse errorCategory before model/UI use; never feed empty failure text to the model.
Route built-in and extension execution through one safe executor that catches throws and emits a typed result.
Return interruption as per-turn outcome truth so a concurrent next turn cannot reset shared abort state and resurrect the stopped turn.
Retry with tools disabled only when the failed attempt streamed no token or reasoning chunk; otherwise rethrow to prevent duplicate output.
Use one bounded tool-call ceiling for JS and native engines, with an explicit continuation notice at the limit.
Tool result content is capped at 24000 characters before being sent back to the model.
LiteRT and JS paths share executeToolCallSafely, toolResultModelContent, and the configured maximum.

direction: Retry a failed streamed request under the same turn identity
reason: OGAM marks whether output streamed and refuses the no-tools retry after any token or reasoning chunk because it would duplicate output to the same consumer.
